explanation_result.explanation:
-3.7% day-over-day move (z-score -2.02) on 2022-04-13. Reason given by 1 report from that day:
- "Acar bruto fecha em baixa após avançar para perto de máxima de 5 meses na ICE" (istoe.com.br, 2022-04-13). Reported move: down 3.6%. Reason: decline in ICE certified stocks. Quote: "declínio contínuo nos estoques certificados pela ICE" (source: 1313f5adad6cf4fd)
Pointing the other way, 1 report from that day:
- "Peabirus : Valorizao nos preços do caf" (redepeabirus.com.br, 2022-04-13). Reported move: up, size not stated. Reason: international price rise and seller retreat. Quote: "alta dos preços internacionais e à retração de vendedores" (source: dd58175e9a6522e6)
